name: compress
description: Compress and extract archives. Supports zip, tar.gz, and tar.bz2 formats.

path.description: Archive path (or source path for compress)

manual.overview: Use when you need to create or extract archives—zip, tar.gz, tar.bz2. Useful for bundling files or unpacking downloads.
tips: Use output without extension for compress; tool appends format
Extract to an empty or new dir to avoid overwriting
zip is portable; tar.gz/tar.bz2 common for Unix bundles
edge_cases: Extracting to existing dir may overwrite files without warning
Very large archives can exhaust disk or memory

executor.command: python -c "import shutil, zipfile, tarfile, json, sys; action='{{args.action}}'; path='{{args.path}}'; out='{{args.output}}'; fmt='{{args.format}}'; r=''; exec('if action=="compress": shutil.make_archive(out,fmt.replace(\".\",\"\"),\".\",path); r=f\"Compressed to {out}.{fmt}\"') if action=='compress' else exec('if action=="extract": shutil.unpack_archive(path,out); r=f\"Extracted to {out}\"') if action=='extract' else exec('import zipfile; zf=zipfile.ZipFile(path); r=chr(10).join(zf.namelist())') if fmt=='zip' else None; print(r)"
